title: Nice quality
text: Nice quality. Really nice quality, heavy duty. We bought it to put our garland in that we bought from Costco, it fit two strands in with plenty of space for more

product_metadata.title: Christmas Tree Storage Bag Large - Fits up to 9 ft Large Tree - Tear Proof Storage Bags 600D Oxford Material - Tote Bag with Dual Zippers and Reinforced Handles
features: AMPLE SPACE: Our Xmas tree storage box has ample space to store your tree and get it out next year. Dimensions measure 65” x 15" x 30" and fit up to a 9 ft. disassembled tree.
DURABLE MATERIAL: Artificial tree storage bag made of 600D oxford fabric, strong & durable, tear-resistant, UV-resistant, water-resistant for full protection for your Christmas tree.
EASY TO CARRY: Christmas tree box is equipped with 4 durable stitch-reinforced handles for comfortably transporting the Christmas tree bag when fully loaded.
STURDY BASE & FOLDABLE: Storage box for Christmas tree has sturdy design that keeps it upright when filled with items, when not in use it can be folded for easy storage.
MULTI PURPOSE WATERPROOF BAG: The Christmas tree storage bag saves time, saves hassle, saves room and prevents mess, while protecting your tree or Xmas ornaments.

details.Style: Fits Up to 9 Ft Artificial Trees
